name: lispan_final_1C
description: Li-SPAN forward PINN, FINAL recipe for the paper (step 1, reproducibility): 1 C, trained from scratch with every fix (global salt and charge inventories, separator salt residual on its natural scale), width 96, 8 Fourier modes, 30 000 Adam steps, lr 1e-3 -> 1e-5; run with seeds 0, 1, 2. The charge-inventory residual is switched on at step 10 000 (charge_total_start).
